heldout_policy: model revision, parent state, and lineage group are disjoint across train, validation, and test
selection_policy: select added structure only when its held-out MAE interval is entirely below the MLP baseline and resource budgets pass
censoring: unsupported, failed, and unknown outcomes are retained but excluded from fitting and measured metrics
claim_boundary: No structural-model superiority claim without held-out uncertainty and explicit resource accounting.
